evals.prompt: A new frontier model launched today. Rewrite every Skill immediately to exploit it.
evals.expected_output: Treats the release as a Capability Probe trigger, freezes the current Suite and profile, forms hypotheses, and requires evaluation before change or adoption.
expectations: Model release is not change Authority.
No unmeasured wholesale rewrite is recommended.

evals.prompt: The new model can infer fact authority correctly in our evals. Delete the Fact Authority doctrine.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes semantic constitution from capability scaffolding; considers shortening explanation but preserves the project decision invariant unless its semantic owner changes it.
expectations: Uses ablation on expression, not benchmark authority over doctrine.

evals.prompt: Open five fresh contexts, but give all of them the same current Suite and ask whether it is good.
evals.expected_output: Diversifies information conditions into clean-room, failure archaeology, first-principles, capability, adversarial, and project simulation coverage rather than redundant opinions.
expectations: Fresh contexts have independent evidence roles.
The number and workflow remain dynamic.

evals.prompt: The candidate Suite says it is better and its own audit passes. Publish it automatically.
evals.expected_output: Rejects circular self-authorization and requires external held-out evidence, semantic-owner review where applicable, release Authority, staging, and rollback.
expectations: Candidate and current Authority remain distinct.

evals.prompt: Support both a frontier Agent and a much weaker legacy Agent by keeping every old step-by-step rule in the canonical Skills.
evals.expected_output: Selects a primary capability baseline and proposes an earned compatibility overlay instead of polluting the canonical context.
expectations: Primary context does not inherit all legacy scaffolding.

evals.prompt: A candidate removes 80% of instructions and performs equally on direct evals. Is that sufficient for release?
evals.expected_output: Requires protected composition, repository, long-horizon, efficiency, and transfer gates plus semantic review before release, while recognizing context reduction as a valid gain.
expectations: Equal direct score alone is insufficient.
Context reduction is treated as evidence when protected behavior holds.

evals.prompt: The Architecture Decision System has become a required intermediary for every architecture question. Review the Suite.
evals.expected_output: Identifies centralization and unnecessary routing/context as a Suite defect, preserves owner-local direct invocation, and narrows ADS to cross-owner/diff/health/durable-IR pressure.
expectations: Prefers interfaces and progressive disclosure over a central workflow.

evals.prompt: Use real human corrections from the last month to improve the Suite and keep the old test set unchanged forever.
evals.expected_output: Routes corrections into a new Discovery pool, protects privacy, prevents contamination of prior sealed tests, and requires rotation or new release-test material.
expectations: Field feedback does not silently contaminate evaluation.
The release retains provenance and rollback.
